ITEM 1 | Pinkish-orange cooked fish fillet pieces with flaky, moist texture and light glaze sheen, some browned edges, sitting at upper-center of plate, roughly 2 pieces each about 4 x 3 cm and 1.5 cm thick, partly overlapping with rice | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale tan cooked brown rice with visible grains and small green flecks, moist and loose, forming a mound about 8 x 5 cm and 1.5 cm high on left-center of plate, with a few scattered toasted seeds or grains | 95
ITEM 3 | Bright yellow squash chunks, smooth glossy skin, firm, cut into rounded pieces about 2 to 3 cm, some with slightly darker edges, clustered left of center below rice | 60
ITEM 4 | Pale green cucumber cubes, about 1.5 to 2 cm, with smooth translucent-green skin and crisp, moist-looking cut faces, lying bottom-left next to yellow squash | 40
ITEM 5 | Fresh dark green leafy greens, mostly spinach-like leaves with some stems, slightly wilted and glossy, spread over the lower-right quadrant about 10 x 8 cm, with small white crumbles and a few dark red bits scattered on top | 55
ITEM 6 | Dark green herb or leafy garnish pieces scattered over the fish and rice, flat leaves with some stems, small quantity, on upper-right of plate | 8
